AgentRegistration.description:
An AI Employee's registration record.

Captures identity, role, capabilities, authority, tools, memory access,
goals, policies, status, and version (Phase 7 spec).
AgentRegistration.title: AgentRegistration

AgentStatus.description: Lifecycle status (subset of Genesis §7 relevant to the registry).
AgentStatus.title: AgentStatus

AssembledPrompt.description: A dynamically assembled prompt — never a static template.
AssembledPrompt.title: AssembledPrompt

AuthorityLevel.description:
Governed-autonomy levels A0-A5 (Genesis glossary §8).

Integer-valued so ``min()`` composes an effective authority and comparisons
are natural. Names mirror the specification exactly.
AuthorityLevel.title: AuthorityLevel

BuiltContext.description: The optimised, token-bounded context assembled for a reasoning step.
BuiltContext.title: BuiltContext

CognitiveEvent.description: An immutable domain event with the canonical Genesis envelope.
CognitiveEvent.title: CognitiveEvent

ContextSection.description: One labelled section of a built context (e.g. 'goals', 'memories').
ContextSection.title: ContextSection

EpisodicEvent.description:
A recorded experience. Fields mirror the Phase 7 specification exactly.

``organization`` is the tenant; ``actor`` is who/what caused it;
``conversation`` / ``customer`` / ``project`` are cross-context references by
ID (never foreign keys — Genesis integrates contexts by ID).
EpisodicEvent.title: EpisodicEvent

Goal.description: A goal in the hierarchy with priority, dependencies, and progress.
Goal.title: Goal

GoalHistoryEntry.description: An append-only record of a change to a goal.
GoalHistoryEntry.title: GoalHistoryEntry

MemoryType.description: The six canonical memory types (Genesis glossary §5).
MemoryType.title: MemoryType

ModuleManifest.description:
The platform's module manifest: what exists, what's reserved, and the
compliance controls outreach modules must ship with.
ModuleManifest.title: ModuleManifest

Plan.description: A decomposition of a goal into an ordered/parallel set of tasks.
Plan.title: Plan

PlanTask.description: A single task within a plan.
PlanTask.title: PlanTask

Policy.description:
A single policy rule.

``action`` and ``resource`` support a trailing ``*`` wildcard. ``min_authority``
is the authority an actor must hold for the action; if the actor holds less,
the effect is escalated to ``require_approval`` (never silently allowed).
Policy.title: Policy

PolicyDecision.description: The engine's ruling, with the deciding rule and a human-readable reason.
PolicyDecision.title: PolicyDecision

Procedure.description: A reusable workflow definition held in procedural memory.
Procedure.title: Procedure

ProcedureStep.description: One ordered step in a procedure.
ProcedureStep.title: ProcedureStep

Relationship.description: A typed, directed relationship between two semantic entities.
Relationship.title: Relationship

SemanticItem.description: A concept or fact in semantic memory, versioned and provenance-tracked.
SemanticItem.title: SemanticItem

SideEffect.description: How consequential invoking a tool is — drives approval requirements.
SideEffect.title: SideEffect

ToolDefinition.description:
A registered tool a capability can execute.

Exposes name, version, permissions, input/output schemas, health, and
timeout (Phase 7 spec).
ToolDefinition.title: ToolDefinition

UserRole.description:
Platform-wide roles. Fine-grained permissions arrive in a later phase;
every permission check today reduces to one of these.
UserRole.title: UserRole

WorkingMemoryEntry.description:
A single item held in an agent's working memory.

Short-lived, token-aware, and versioned. ``expires_at`` drives automatic
expiry; ``relevance`` orders entries when the budget forces truncation.
WorkingMemoryEntry.title: WorkingMemoryEntry

WorkingSet.description: An assembled, token-bounded view of working memory for one scope.
WorkingSet.title: WorkingSet
